User.title: User Profile Document
User.description: Represents biographical logs, career trajectories, and trade expertise reflections curated by certified human professionals.

name.description: Display name of the human professional.

photoURL.description: Secure reference URL for the portrait photograph.

profession.description: The trade specialty or active career description.

bio.description: Short introductory synopsis summarizing life path.

story.description: Exhaustive reflective narrative detailing career pivots, struggles, and values.

dailyLife.description: Reflective routine, schedule chronology, or daily structure.

lessonsLearned.description: Synthesized experience guidelines and fundamental lessons.

expertiseTags.description: Highly structured concept indices and specialty tags.

experienceTags.description: Decisive life milestones, failures, and inflection points.

projects.description: Portfolios, collaborative cooperatives, and initiative URLs.

socialLinks.description: Secure verified anchors to personal directories, GitHub, and professional networks.

availability.description: Signals and bandwidth limits set for mentoring, collaboration, or receiving queries.

yearsOfExperience.description: Total number of years active in the specified trade.

views.description: Read volumes logged by active search queries.

isDraft.description: State flag representing private drafting status.

moderationStatus.description: Current status in the content moderation queue.

Question.title: Advisory Inquiry Document
Question.description: Represents an advisory text question asked by directory visitors requesting career advice.

profileOwnerId.description: Target professional ID receiving the inquiry.

askerId.description: The unique sender ID or 'anonymous' identifier.

askerName.description: Sender signature displayed on answers boards.

question.description: Core descriptive text inquiry composed by visitor.

answer.description: Thoughtful written response back-logged by the targeted professional.

visibility.description: Indicates whether the inquiry can be exhibited on public boards.

Bookmark.title: Library Bookmark Registration
Bookmark.description: An identifier mapping representing a saved book reference in a user's library.

userId.description: Active user ID bookmark is registered under.

Role.title: User Authorization Role
Role.description: Provides system permission tiers ('admin', 'moderator', 'user') assigned to verified human library cards.

email.description: Verified email address of the credential holder.

Report.title: Content Abuse Report
Report.description: System report filed by users regarding profiles or questions containing unvetted/abusive content.

reporterId.description: The unique user UID filing the report.

itemId.description: Reference identifier of the targeted resource.

itemTitle.description: Name or identifier representing the reported entity.

Notification.title: System Alert Notification
Notification.description: System notification dispatched to key users concerning account updates or moderation decisions.

message.description: Detailed explanation of the moderation decision.

users/{uid}.description: Stores professional biography indices mapping to their verified credential IDs.

questions/{id}.description: Hosts direct advisory logs, text queries, and target responds.

bookmarks/{id}.description: Aggregates personal catalog selections and library entries.

roles/{userId}.description: System permission levels assigned to user credentials, regulating access to mod panels.

reports/{reportId}.description: Hosts profile and advisory questions filed for review.

notifications/{notificationId}.description: Dispatches decision alert summaries to users.
